items.name: Appleby Winter B 2023

venue.name: [Appleby College](https://www.appleby.on.ca/) A.W.B. Alumni Centre for Athletics and Student Life
venue.address: 540 Lakeshore Rd W, Oakville, ON L6K 3P1
venue.details: Double Gymnasium on the lower level of the building

items.information:
## Appleby Winter 2023 Series

This competition is in a series with [Appleby Winter A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ApplebyWinterA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminder

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

## No Food or Drink

Appleby College does **not** allow food or drink inside the gymnasium. Please consume any food or drink outside the gymnasium or off-site.

**Español**

Han pasado más de 5 años sin campeonatos en la quinta región y comenzamos este nuevo año con Montealegre Open 2023, en la querida ciudad de Valparaíso. Esperamos que este campeonato sea el inicio de un año lleno de alegrías y emociones para el speedcubing.

¡Te estamos esperando!

**English**

More than 5 years have passed without championships in the fifth region and we begin this new year with Montealegre Open 2023, in the beloved city of Valparaíso. We hope that this championship is the beginning of a year full of joys and emotions for speedcubing.

We are waiting for you!

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab.

All competitors must read the COVID Safety tab before registering, as proof of full vaccination or a negative test will be required. **Competitors may bring at most one guest.**

items.information:
This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are **required to purchase a day pass** to the science center to enter the competition. A day pass is included in the competitor registration fee.

Imagination Station opens at 12pm, but will be allowing in competitors and their families starting at 11:30am. Please do not arrive earlier than 11:30am.

Directions and parking instructions:

items.name: Colorado Trifecta 2023

venue.name: [Douglas County Libraries - Parker Branch](https://www.dcl.org/parker/)
venue.details: Competition will be held in Event Halls A and B

items.information:
### This competition takes place on a Sunday. Please plan accordingly.


### This competition does not have 3x3 or other standard events. Please be aware of this as you register. 

**The main event of this competition is Clock**

Join us in Denver for a trifecta of events and rounds! Are you a clock or square-1 solver? An FMC aficionado? You won't want to miss this amazing competition!

All competitors should read the **Competitor Responsibilities and COVID-19 Safety** tab before registering

There is no mask policy at the venue, but we still encourage anyone that wishes to wear one to do so. If the situation regarding COVID-19 worsens, masks may become a requirement closer to the competition. 

The competitor limit for this competition is 55 competitors. No guest limit is being enforced for this event, but we ask you to bring a maximum of two only.
